description: Resting order book depth for one Hyperliquid market: spread, top of book, and how much size sits on each side. Pass size_usd to walk the book for that trade and get the average fill price and slippage — or a clear statement that the visible book is not deep enough to answer, which is common for large sizes. Answers "can I actually get in or out at this size", which price and volume alone do not. Read-only, public data, no API key.

market.description: Which book to read. Default perp.

size_usd.description: Trade size in USD to simulate against the book. Omitted = depth summary only.

symbol.description: Market symbol, e.g. HYPE or BTC. For spot pass the pair, e.g. PURR/USDC.

name: hl_orderbook
title: Order book depth
